name: hcapp_deleteTrackImport
description: Clears one of the caller's own track-import uploads off their Import Tracks list by stamping DeletedAt. The row and its BlobUrl are kept (the archives are retained for historic-run discovery); tracks already imported from the upload are untouched.

parameters.name: jobId
parameters.description: The upload to clear. Must belong to the caller and must not be mid-import.

rowsets.name: SuccessEnvelope
rowsets.description: Envelope only. { success } on success; { success, errorCode, errorType } on failure.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: 1011 not found or not the caller's, 1012 still processing, 1013 unhandled.

columns.name: jobId
columns.description: Echo of the cleared upload's id.

rowsets.description: Returned in place of DeletedJob on any failure.

sideEffects: Stamps HC.TrackImport.DeletedAt. The blob is NOT deleted and imported tracks are NOT removed.
breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
